# truenas_network_config (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS global network configuration (hostname, domain, DNS servers, default gateways, service announcement). This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one global network configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls network.configuration.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place). WARNING: hostname affects how the system identifies itself on the network, and ipv4gateway/ipv6gateway affect outbound network connectivity; changing them incorrectly can disrupt access to the system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_network_config" "config" {
  hostname    = "truenas"
  domain      = "example.com"
  nameserver1 = "8.8.8.8"
  nameserver2 = "8.8.4.4"

  service_announcement = {
    mdns    = true
    netbios = true
    wsd     = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Primary DNS domain name.
- `domains` (List of String) Additional DNS search domains.
- `hostname` (String) System hostname. WARNING: this affects how the system identifies itself on the network (e.g. in directory services, certificates, and other services keyed on hostname).
- `hosts` (List of String) Additional /etc/hosts entries.
- `httpproxy` (String) HTTP proxy URL used by the system for outbound HTTP(S) requests.
- `ipv4gateway` (String) Default IPv4 gateway. An empty string clears the assigned gateway (null on the wire). WARNING: changing this can disrupt outbound network connectivity to the system.
- `ipv6gateway` (String) Default IPv6 gateway. An empty string clears the assigned gateway (null on the wire). WARNING: changing this can disrupt outbound network connectivity to the system.
- `nameserver1` (String) Primary DNS nameserver. An empty string clears the assigned nameserver (null on the wire).
- `nameserver2` (String) Secondary DNS nameserver. An empty string clears the assigned nameserver (null on the wire).
- `nameserver3` (String) Tertiary DNS nameserver. An empty string clears the assigned nameserver (null on the wire).
- `service_announcement` (Attributes) Network service announcement/discovery protocols enabled on the system. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_announcement))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "network_config".

<a id="nestedatt--service_announcement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_announcement`

Required:

- `mdns` (Boolean) Enable mDNS (multicast DNS) service announcement.
- `netbios` (Boolean) Enable NetBIOS name service announcement.
- `wsd` (Boolean) Enable WS-Discovery service announcement.
